final: SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(e.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(status_avg_imgcount) FROM (SELECT AVG(e2.imgcount) AS status_avg_imgcount FROM scanenvironment e2 JOIN sites s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = e2.zoneref GROUP BY s2.entrystat)) AS imgcount_avg_minus_equal_status_mean FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY s.entrystat
